name: gemma-4-12B-agentic-fable5-composer2.5-v2-3.5x-tau2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-12B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 1)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of google/gemma-4-12B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 11.96 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-28. CAVEAT: one published row, printed as approximations ('~15%' base, '~55%' this model) from a local 20-task self-eval with a self-simulated user at Q8_0 — the card itself says the numbers are not comparable to the tau2-bench leaderboard. The card also states MMLU-Pro lands below base. Kept as a record because a column for this repo and a column for the base do exist in the same table, but this is the weakest evidence in the batch.

benchmarks.config: Card table 'tau2-bench telecom - 20 tasks - local, same harness, all Q8_0': this model '~55%' vs 'official gemma-4-12B-it (base)' '~15%'.
